description: A sample note queried verbatim plus its one-property edit (exclamation); the slot claims quote.

texts:
Hi Shay,
She spent most weekends roasting vegetables at the kitchen. Her neighbor said it was a rewarding way to pass the time. She practiced with a neighbor most evenings. She owned two cookbooks and kept buying more. She loved every minute of it. You should try it with her.
Speak soon,
Ellis
P.S. Bring an umbrella next time.
